comparison.objective: Serve one meatball using a clean scoop without cross-contamination.
comparison.physical_skill: Contact-based scooping, transport, utensil selection, and contamination-aware handling.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one meatball is supported by the clean scoop, delivered onto the plate, released stably, and never contaminated or directly handled.
comparison.reason: Tests hygienic transfer of food with a utensil; it has no coaxial tool alignment, controlled fracture, retained hardware, or loose-metal recovery.
